Getting started with netfs

Source: vignettes/getting-started.Rmd
getting-started.Rmd
library(netfs)

Local filesystem operations

With no connection, netfs delegates directly to fs.

dir_ls(tempdir())
## /tmp/RtmpTTKK9Q/file1d345c826884
## /tmp/RtmpTTKK9Q/rmarkdown-str1d34100c1e85.html
file_exists(tempdir())
## /tmp/RtmpTTKK9Q 
##            TRUE

Connection objects

Constructors validate configuration without opening a connection. Passwords are stored through keyring and are not retained in connection objects.

server <- ftp("ftp.example.org", user = "analyst")
set_creds(server)

Set NETFS_KEYRING in .Renviron to select a named keyring. Do not store the password itself in .Renviron.

SSH 

server <- ssh("server.example.org", user = "user")
dir_ls("/data", con = server)

FTP 

server <- ftp("ftp.example.org", user = "user")
file_info("/data/input.csv", con = server)

SMB 

server <- smb("fileserver", "DATA", user = "user")
dir_ls("/2026", con = server)

Uploading and downloading files

file_download() copies from remote to local. file_upload() copies in the other direction. Both protect existing destinations unless overwrite = TRUE.

file_transfer() copies between two remote connections through a temporary local staging file. It preserves the source and removes the temporary file after success or failure.

file_transfer(
  "/incoming/report.csv",
  "/archive/",
  from = ftp_server,
  to = smb_server
)

Backend capabilities 

netfs_capabilities()
## # A tibble: 6 × 4
##   backend available engine    package   
##   <chr>   <lgl>     <chr>     <chr>     
## 1 local   TRUE      libuv     fs        
## 2 ftp     TRUE      libcurl   curl      
## 3 ssh     TRUE      openssh   system    
## 4 smb     FALSE     smbclient smbclientr
## 5 webdav  TRUE      httr2     webdav    
## 6 s3      TRUE      paws      s3fs

Error handling

Remote failures inherit from netfs_error; specific subclasses distinguish authentication, missing paths, unavailable clients, timeouts, and unsupported operations.
